To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ICTs-based healthcare applications have been evolving over the last years, and they are expected to evolve further, with the adoption of the most recent technological advances.

(i) ICTs are enabling a number of healthcare application scenarios, with a focus to the ones that can benefit from the integration of most if not of all ICTs pillars; (ii) ICTs are fostering the generation of healthcare data, which may be structured in different ways; (iii) the adoption of ICTs in the healthcare domain is still a challenging task due to the complexity of the domain, the heterogeneity of the involved stakeholders and the criticality of the applications.
ICTs are a key enabler to improve health services, and that ICTs can be used to improve the quality of life of people, to reduce the costs of healthcare, and to provide a better quality of care.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of ICTs-based healthcare application paradigms and the technological pillars underlining them.

a comprehensive and up-to-date analysis of the state of the art and of the state of practice of ICTs in healthcare, with a special focus on their main application scenarios, as well as on the related research challenges.
the identification of the most popular ICT-based healthcare paradigmas, the main ICTs enabling them, and the main challenges that the adoption of ICTs poses in the healthcare domain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ICTs advancements are providing the healthcare domain with a number of opportunities, but also with a number of challenges.
ICTs are a key enabler for the future of healthcare, but a lot of research is still needed to fully exploit the potentialities of ICTs in the healthcare domain.
ICTs and healthcare have been and will be more and more intertwined, and that the scientific community has to face new research challenges in order to make the best of this fruitful relationship.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ICTs evolution is fostering the development of novel healthcare paradigms and application scenarios, which are expected to have an impact on the healthcare sector.
we provide a taxonomy of the main ICTs paradigms in healthcare and their related data models, with a focus at the hottest research challenges in each of the identified application scenarios.
the scientific literature is quite scattered and fragmented and, as a result, the holistic view of how ICTs are able, today, to support healthcare is not yet fully available.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ICTs-based healthcare scenarios have been recently boosted, and they are likely to continue to do so.
the adoption of ICTs is expected to be more and more pervasive, and the related research challenges should be addressed as early as possible.
ICTs have a great potential to improve the healthcare domain, but the scientific literature appears still fragmented, and a holistic view is still missing.
